CheckTitle: At least one active block zone exists for admin-defined high-risk countries
Description: Checks that at least one active country-based block zone exists.
Risk: Without country-based block zones, tenants cannot enforce simple geography-based access restrictions.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Networks.
2. Create a network zone using geolocations for countries your organization has approved for blocking.
3. Configure the zone as a block zone or use it in sign-on policies that deny access.
4. Activate the zone and document the country selection rationale.
5. Review the list periodically with security and business owners.

Recommendation.Text: Create at least one active country-based block zone for admin-defined high-risk geographies.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
